$comment: The mail contract: every template the mailer and the dispatcher render, its parameters as a JSON Schema subset, and examples. See README.md.

printable.description: A value the template prints: text, a number, true/false or null (printed as nothing).

token.description: A confirmation or reset token; it goes into a link.

questions.description: The event's application questions; the template lists each with the answer at the same position.

event_link.description: An event the mail names and links to.

event_questions.description: An event whose name is in the subject line and whose questions are listed.

candidate_applied.description: Notice of a new candidature for a position.

confirm_email.description: Signup confirmation with the confirmation token; greets with first name and surname.

custom.description: A mail whose HTML the sender writes; email_body is rendered without escaping. A list of parameter objects gives one body per address in "to".

parameters.email_body:
Hello Ada,

Your code for Example Partner is CODE-1234.

Dear board of AEGEE-Delft,

Please send your activity report.

Dear participants of Agora Example,

See you soon!
